title: i3blocks: no gaming or shadow block once gaming is not limited
objective: Remove [gaming_budget] and [leisure_shadow] from the i3blocks config and make both scripts print nothing when daily-limits' cache has gaming_enforced false; a missing or true key keeps current behaviour; both always exit 0 and stay shellcheck clean.
acceptance_criteria: gaming_enforced false: gaming_budget and leisure_shadow print 0 lines and exit 0, even for stale or no-data caches
gaming_enforced missing or true: output identical to before
the config wires neither block; shutdown_countdown, tutor and focus_project sections are unchanged
